name: captain-cod-earnings
objective: Replace conflicting captain COD custody/remit semantics with atomic one-wallet financial authorization and align delivery/commission earnings without double counting.
truthOwner: WLT owns COD financial exposure and earnings; DSH owns order/assignment operational state and invokes trusted WLT transitions.

tasks.objective: Implement order-specific atomic captain COD authorization/reserve from the canonical wallet.
tasks.currentProblem: Current captain COD uses collection/remittance states and does not represent funded-wallet capacity as the canonical financial effect.
tasks.requiredChange: Create canonical COD authorization/reserve state tied to PaymentAllocation/order/captain, lock the wallet/order records atomically, and reject insufficient or concurrently consumed balance.
tasks.targetState: Only one captain/order reservation exists; available capacity cannot be overcommitted under races.
tasks.action: Extend WLT COD/domain/database and DSH assignment integration so assignment acceptance and financial authorization have a safe transaction/compensation boundary.
mustNotChange: Do not use future delivery earnings as current COD capacity.
Do not let DSH calculate wallet sufficiency.
Do not create a second captain wallet for COD.
acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent assignment tests permit at most the financially valid reservations.
Insufficient balance fails before irreversible assignment state.
Reservation is idempotent by order/captain purpose.
tasks.rollback: On cross-service failure, use explicit compensation/retry state; never invent balance or silently assign without financial authorization.

tasks.objective: Implement cancellation release and delivery finalization exactly once, eliminating double COD effects.
tasks.currentProblem: Legacy collect/remit can coexist accidentally with a funded-wallet debit and charge the same order value twice.
tasks.requiredChange: New captain-funded COD transitions release the reserve once on valid cancellation and finalize/debit once on valid delivery; disable legacy captain collect/remit writers for new funded-wallet orders and preserve historical records.
tasks.targetState: Each order has one economic COD effect and a complete audit trail; duplicate/replay/race transitions are rejected or idempotent.
tasks.action: Add explicit state transition guards and compatibility projection for old rows, then remove new-write reachability to legacy captain custody/remit paths.
mustNotChange: Do not rewrite historical COD evidence.
Do not delete non-captain custody behavior without separate product authority.
Do not allow both funded-wallet debit and remittance liability for one captain order.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate collect/remit endpoint cannot add a second effect to a new funded-wallet captain order.
tasks.rollback: Keep historical compatibility reads and roll forward state guards; never reactivate double-effect writers as rollback.

tasks.objective: Post captain delivery earnings and field/other commissions from authoritative earning events without delivery-fee duplication.
tasks.currentProblem: Commission primitives exist but the target requires one consistent relationship between PaymentAllocation, order completion and stakeholder earnings.
tasks.requiredChange: Use canonical policy/source IDs and idempotent ledger postings; credit earnings only when the source event is authoritative and ensure delivery fee is allocated once.
tasks.targetState: Captain/field/partner earnings are traceable to source order/visit/policy and visible through one wallet ledger.
tasks.action: Extend existing commission governance/create paths instead of creating new local earnings stores; add reversal/adjustment through compensating ledger entries.
mustNotChange: Do not accept caller-computed commission amounts when a canonical policy owns calculation.
Do not credit delivery earning before authoritative earning state.
Do not double count delivery fee in partner/captain postings.
acceptanceCriteria: Wallet readback reconciles to ledger earnings.
tasks.rollback: Reverse erroneous candidate postings with compensating entries; preserve source event lineage.
